actions.description: Verify health, record round-trip, and service restart persistence
actions.command:
set -eu
body=/tmp/builder-contract-body
retrieved=/tmp/builder-contract-retrieved
health=/tmp/builder-contract-health
printf 'binary\000payload\nwith exact bytes' > "$body"
health_status=$(curl --silent --show-error --output "$health" --write-out '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/health)
test "$health_status" = 200
printf 'ready' | cmp -s - "$health"
